name: Facet
text: Implement a persistent dark theme with a high-contrast light mode toggle. This maximizes visibility and reduces eye strain during long sessions, aligning with our competitive analysis findings. The trade-off is slightly higher battery drain on OLED screens, but the clarity and enjoyment gains outweigh it. Default to the system’s theme on first load to respect user preference without friction.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t preference—it’s habituation. Users won’t switch from dark mode once set, making the toggle a placebo for poor defaults. Better: default to high-contrast light mode for first-time users, then let them opt into dark mode with a one-time prompt. Settle it with A/B testing: measure task completion speed and eye strain metrics across both groups.
